title: Investors Put Faith In Apple. How High Can This Stock Rise?
text: Investors Put Faith In Apple. How High Can This Stock Rise? Exactly 3 months ago, when our report on Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) was published on 3rd Feb, our short term outlook was bearish and the market went through a quick and aggressive correction that made Apple's stock price tumble as well.
